title: Resume a suspended command in the background
summary: If you paused a running command (usually by pressing Ctrl+Z), you can resume it so it keeps running in the background, freeing up your terminal for other tasks.

steps.explain: Resume the most recently suspended job in the background.
steps.expect: The job resumes and the terminal prompt returns, allowing you to type new commands.

steps.explain: Resume a specific suspended job by its job number. Use `jobs` to find the job number if you don't know it.

placeholders.name: JOB_NUMBER
placeholders.description: The number of the suspended job (e.g., 1, 2).

steps.expect: The specified job resumes in the background.
